title: Credential Dump on Domain Controller
root_cause: Root cause traced to: Unusual process opened a handle to LSASS.exe with dumping-capable access rights (ATT&CK stage: Credential Access).

timeline.description: Unusual process opened a handle to LSASS.exe with dumping-capable access rights
Credential dumping tool signature detected in process memory
Dumped hash reused to authenticate to a second domain controller

recommended_action: Isolate affected hosts from the network and audit lateral movement paths.
executive_summary: Credential theft activity was identified affecting endpoint DC-01 and domain corp.hawkeye.local, involving Credential Access -> Lateral Movement. Immediate network isolation is recommended to prevent further spread.
